algorithms: unchanged characterization_v5 constant, linear, ridge, relative-weighted linear/ridge and depth2/3/4 trees; model_training.algorithms
group: stage and semantic operation; jointly retain result shape, width, target and load features
delay_margin: positive validation underprediction p95 plus max(1ps, ABC*0.001), per candidate; no independent test used
quality_scope: each operation and stage separately, after applying the frozen delay margin; also report point metrics
feasibility_scope: report synthetic local QD budgets and measured target minus observed H; H is evaluation-only and never an inference feature
selection: validation-ready first, normalized MAE, p95, serialized size and stable algorithm name; unready operation cannot release its test
independent_test: all grt operations validation-ready, full168 collection and byte-identical refit before any of the registered56 F4 tasks; evaluate once after parameter/margin/domain freeze
production_domain: only measured integer widths/result shapes and registered ABC/SDC points, single capture bank; no unqualified combination/stage/state/interval or target interpolation claim
